agents.title: CEO
agents.description: Strategic lead: decomposes the startup idea, reviews product, engineering, and QA outputs, and posts the final team summary to Slack.

agents.title: Product
agents.description: Owns the product specification—personas, features, and user stories—refined with the CEO until accepted.

agents.title: Engineer
agents.description: Builds the landing page on GitHub: issue, branch, commits, and pull request from the approved spec.

agents.title: Marketing
agents.description: Produces launch messaging: tagline, cold email, and Slack Block Kit, using the PR URL from the CEO handoff.

agents.title: QA
agents.description: Reviews the pull request, HTML, and marketing assets against the product spec and returns structured findings.
